text:
sophia: thinking out loud — we should standardize a 6/12 month commitment window for marketplace offers, with an optional HW kicker for SI + hardware partners. keeps sales messaging simpler and aligns renewals.

ellie: we can do a hw kicker but need clarity on structure. propose: 1) credit % on committed spend 2) one-time HW co-fund for year 1 only 3) ramp-down on renewal credits. example: `commit >= $200k -> 8% credit + $50k hw co-fund`

mike: +1 on standard windows. sales needs clear thresholds and a short one-pager for AE enablement. also prefer a mid-year checkpoint (month 6) so we can convert usage data into renewal upsell motions.

anna: I'll draft the AE one-pager once we lock thresholds. can we keep the marketing/announce cadence to 2 weeks after PO execution? want to avoid customers seeing public SKUs before legal signs off. :eyes:

raj: legal note — any co-fund language must be tied to a valid SOW and explicit eligible SKUs. we should avoid language that looks like a rebate. need a clause: "credits applied only against marketplace spend; non-transferable; expires 12 months from grant."

partnerships-bot: Reminder: please upload the final offer terms to the partner folder: <https://notion.redwood.com/partners/offers|partner-offers>

ellie: agreed on Raj's clause. also we need a simple API-friendly SKU mapping so we can pass credits into partner billing systems. sample mapping snippet:```sku_map: { "redwood-dedicated": "HW-KICK-01", "redwood-hosted": "HW-KICK-02" }```

mike: for renewals, propose a sliding credit: 8% first year, 4% renewal if commit maintained, 0% if commit drops >30%. helps reduce churning for committed customers.

anna: note for playbook — two partner-facing templates: 1) co-funded (hw + credit) 2) credit-only. marketing to prep joint announcement copy for each template.

raj: one more — ensure all offers include a minimum usage floor to prevent gaming. suggest a $50k quarterly minimum for any 12-month commit.

ellie: we'll commit to the $50k floor for co-fund cases but may ask for a short ramp (first quarter at 60%) depending on partner onboarding constraints.

mike: timeline check — can Partnerships + Legal + Sales sign off on template by EOW (end of week)? if yes, ops can start creating PO SKUs.

sophia: EOW sign-off works if everyone responds by Thursday COB. I'll assemble a final draft and post in this thread tomorrow. thanks all. :sparkles:
